text:
sam: Quick sync — we want to gate the new adaptive-quota heuristic in Console at 2% traffic. It relies on a new tiny header we call `route-q` (replaces `route-quality`) and an opt-in telemetry flag `route_q_telemetry=true`. Need SDK plan. :eyes:
ana: Can we avoid a hard break? if SDKs accept both headers (`route-quality` fallback -> `route-q`) it should be seamless. docs + deprecation warning instead of immediate break.
kevin: Agree. Console needs to surface the flag + a rollout tile. Also need to ensure quota dashboards don't double-count during the shim.
morgan: Python client: easy to add fallback and emit DeprecationWarning on first use. TS client can do the same and release a patch. Go client is stricter but can treat unknown headers as passthrough; will need a minor semver bump.
sam: Proposed rollout: (1) server-side shim that honors both headers for 2 weeks, (2) release SDK patches that prefer `route-q` but accept fallback + warn, (3) console rollout toggles telemetry by org + add docs, (4) after 4w, remove fallback server-side. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
ana: timeline sounds good. please add clear migration snippet in the migration docs and a FAQ entry about dashboard attribution during overlap.
kevin: Also add a console visualization note: show a small banner on affected dashboards while the shim is active so support sees it.
morgan: Snippet for Python we can include in docs:```python
# new preferred header
headers = {"route-q": "0.78", "route_q_telemetry": "true"}
# fallback logic
if "route-quality" in headers:
    # warn and map
    import warnings
    warnings.warn("route-quality is deprecated, please use route-q", DeprecationWarning)
    headers["route-q"] = headers.pop("route-quality")
```
ana: TS example too, small patch. Also add a small telemetry opt-in checkbox in Console UI so org admins can toggle collection per-tenant for the experiment.
sam: ops note: we should coordinate a canary in us-west-2 first, then global. I'll file the rollout ticket.
deploy-bot: featureflag/adaptive-quota enabled in staging for org: redwood-internal (id: org_12345) — 2026-03-22 15:42 UTC :white_check_mark:
kevin: I'll add the console tile and the banner content, will loop in support docs. :shipit:
nana: I'll draft the migration guide + FAQ and ping @morgan/@sam for review.
sam: thanks team — aim to publish SDK patches EOD Friday and enable shim Monday morning in staging. :thumbsup:
